name: Jane Hawley Stevens
reason: Herbalist and organic farmer whose own business, Four Elements Organic Herbals (North Freedom, Wisconsin), sells medicinal herbal tinctures, salves and teas, many named for body systems or conditions (immune, sinus, liver-kidney, nerve support); her work is mainly herbal medicine and a product brand, so almost nothing passes the health-claim rule. Only the site's robots.txt was read.
